name: boundary_byte_continuity
definition: 1.0 - min(1.0, |p(last_byte_A in A) - p(first_byte_B in B)|) (Frequency matching across boundary byte transition)

leakage_risk: None

name: prefix_suffix_overlap

input_data: Last 8 bytes of A, first 8 bytes of B
leakage_risk: None

name: boundary_format_rule
definition: Rule-based boundary compatibility heuristic: JPEG marker sequence (0xFF+marker -> 1.0), PDF endobj->obj (1.0), MP3 frame sync (1.0), EOF footer before header (0.0), header in B (0.15), default (0.5)
input_data: Boundary bytes A[-1], B[0], and structural marker caches
leakage_risk: None

name: boundary_incomplete_marker
definition: 1.0 if A ends with trailing 0xFF or NALU prefix [0,0,0,1], indicating incomplete multi-byte token, else 0.0
input_data: Trailing bytes of fragment A
leakage_risk: None

name: boundary_frame_alignment
definition: 1.0 if A ends with MP3 frame header byte (0xFB/FA/F3/F2) and B starts with 0xFF, else 0.0
input_data: A[-1] and B[0]
leakage_risk: None

name: boundary_generic_score
definition: clip(0.5 * boundary_format_rule + 0.3 * boundary_byte_continuity + 0.2, 0.0, 1.0)
input_data: Combination of format rule and byte continuity
leakage_risk: None

name: physical_dist_log
definition: log1p(|offset_B - offset_A| / 512) (Logarithm of block offset distance)
input_data: physical_offset metadata of A and B
leakage_risk: CRITICAL LEAKAGE: In training pairs, offset_A and offset_B are offset_in_source, so consecutive fragments of the same file always have physical_dist_log = log1p(1.0) = 0.6931!

name: physical_adjacent
definition: 1.0 if |offset_B - offset_A| / 512 == 1.0 else 0.0
input_data: physical_offset metadata of A and B
leakage_risk: CRITICAL LEAKAGE: In training pairs, offset is offset_in_source, so ALL consecutive positive pairs have physical_adjacent=1.0, directly giving away ground truth adjacency!

name: physical_close
definition: 1.0 if |offset_B - offset_A| / 512 <= 4.0 else 0.0
input_data: physical_offset metadata of A and B
leakage_risk: HIGH LEAKAGE: In training pairs, offset is offset_in_source, so fragments within 4 blocks in the original file have physical_close=1.0.

name: cluster_dist
definition: log1p(|cluster_B - cluster_A|)
input_data: cluster metadata of A and B
leakage_risk: CRITICAL LEAKAGE: In training pairs, cluster is original_position, directly encoding ground-truth sequence index difference!

name: same_cluster
definition: 1.0 if cluster_A == cluster_B else 0.0
input_data: cluster metadata of A and B
leakage_risk: Moderate

name: alloc_status_match
definition: 1.0 if allocation_status_A == allocation_status_B else 0.0
input_data: allocation_status metadata ('allocated', 'unallocated', 'system')
leakage_risk: Low

name: alloc_both_allocated
definition: 1.0 if both A and B have allocation_status == 'allocated' else 0.0
input_data: allocation_status metadata
leakage_risk: Low

name: context_compat
definition: 0.6 * (1.0 - min(1.0, log1p(dist)/8)) + 0.4 * (alloc_A == alloc_B)
input_data: Physical offset distance and allocation status
leakage_risk: HIGH LEAKAGE: Leaks distance based on source offsets during training.
